name: notebook_page
title: Notebook page
description: Used by the notebook view to read its notebook's page in parts: Pluto's, or Ember's for an R notebook.

notebook_id.description: The open notebook the page is for. Without it, Pluto's.

offset.description: Where the part starts: 0, then the `next` of the part before.

name: notebook_socket_open
title: Notebook connection
description: Used by the notebook view to connect to the notebook's Pluto.

name: notebook_socket_send
title: Notebook connection: send
description: Used by the notebook view to send Pluto a message.

name: notebook_socket_recv
title: Notebook connection: receive
description: Used by the notebook view to receive Pluto's messages.

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for a message, at most 1500.

name: notebook_socket_close
title: Notebook connection: close
description: Used by the notebook view when it closes.
